lemmas.statement: The Tao box-grid minimum gap (real-valued) is strictly positive. This is auxiliary certificate data for the Tao branch only and does not establish five-branch routing.
The Haagerup box-grid minimum gap (real-valued) is strictly positive. Auxiliary certificate data for the Haagerup branch only.
Every CHM(6) lies in one of the five branches Fourier, Haagerup, Szollosi, Karlsson, Tao, each certified free of quartet extensions. Open: this is the target restated, not proved.

near_misses.claim: Positivity of the Tao and Haagerup minimum gaps implies the five-branch classification of CHM(6).
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Gap positivity only certifies box separation within two branches; it says nothing about exhaustiveness over all CHM(6), nor about Fourier, Szollosi, Karlsson branches. G1 remains open.
